scaleBasis: Estimate: 1 glTF unit = 1 meter, consistent with source road width; not survey-calibrated.

A.maneuver: five-point turn with four full stops and two actual reverse arcs

B.maneuver: forward semicircle inside original wide turnout

turnoutJoin: Cubic Bezier curves constrained to source road and endpoint headings
integrationRules: Use position and forward independently: on reverse arc gear=-1, vehicle nose opposes travel direction.
Come to a full stop for stopSeconds at the four gear shifts; heading remains continuous.
Never derive body heading from position tangent during reverse segments.
British left-lane offsets are already embedded. Do not apply an additional lane offset.
headingRadians is Three.js Y rotation for a vehicle with its nose along local -Z.
Use the actual road query at each wheel for ground pose; wheelHeights are sampled at estimated 2.7 m wheelbase and 1.55 m track.
No authored forest meshes, materials or terrain were changed.
